question: A bank account is established for a new business customer. The business was established five years ago with an address in another state. The business website contains few details other than stating it is a real estate business. One principal has an international telephone number and appears to be living in another country. The other principal works out of a recreational vehicle. What warrants enhanced due diligence in this scenario?

A branch manager for a small community bank has a new customer who deposits four EUR 50,000 checks into one account. Shortly thereafter, the customer goes to another branch and asks to transfer all but EUR 1,500 to three accounts in different foreign jurisdictions. Which suspicious activity should be the focus of the suspicious transaction report?

options.A: The customer opened the account with four large checks
options.B: The customer goes to a different branch to make this transaction
options.C: The customer transfers almost all of the funds out of the account
options.D: The customer asks to transfer funds to accounts in three different foreign jurisdictions

community_answer: D. The customer asks to transfer funds to accounts in three different foreign jurisdictions

question: A government has instituted new anti-money laundering laws which require all financial institutions to obtain certain information from its customers. Which step should an institution located in this jurisdiction take to ensure compliance?

options.A: Change procedures to require that the necessary information is obtained
options.B: Change procedures and systems as necessary and provide employee training
options.C: Send a notice to customers asking them to provide the necessary information
options.D: Change systems to ensure the required information is automatically obtained from all customers

community_answer: B. Change procedures and systems as necessary and provide employee training

question: An anti-money laundering audit identifies a significant weakness in how transaction monitoring alerts are cleared. Audit sampling identified potentially suspicious activity that was cleared as not suspicious. Management accepts the audit finding and develops a remediation plan. What is the role of the auditor during the correction phase?

options.A: Directing the remediation of the deficiency in a timely manner
options.B: Developing procedures to provide sufficient risk-based documentation for clearing alerts
options.C: Providing training to the alert clearing department on the importance of effective alert clearing
options.D: Validating the successful remediation of the issue once management indicates the issue is resolved

community_answer: D. Validating the successful remediation of the issue once management indicates the issue is resolved

question: Which method to launder money through deposit-taking institutions is closely associated with international trade?

question: An employee hears a colleague on the telephone with a customer giving advice on how to ensure that a suspicious transaction report will not be filed as a result of a future transaction. What action should the employee take?

options.A: Report the conversation to the local police
options.B: Report the conversation to the compliance officer
options.C: Tell the colleague that it is against policy to give such advice
options.D: Ignore the situation because the colleague is the relationship manager for that customer

community_answer: B. Report the conversation to the compliance officer
